semiconductor_relevance: High — Contrel Technology specializes in manufacturing testing and processing equipment for the semiconductor and optoelectronics industries.
summary: Contrel Technology Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced testing and processing equipment for the semiconductor industry, with a strong focus on TFT-LCD and laser technologies. The company has diversified its offerings to include laser applications in PCB and semiconductor manufacturing, positioning itself as a key player in high-tech equipment manufacturing.
capabilities: Laser technology for PCB and semiconductor processing

regional_presence.Taiwan: Contrel Technology has its headquarters in the Southern Taiwan Science Park and additional offices in Central Taiwan Science Park and Hsinchu Science Park.
regional_presence.China: The company has established offices in several cities across Mainland China, including Ningbo, Foshan, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Shanghai, Wuhan, Hefei, and Chengdu.
